key.name: instances
key.description: Comma-separated list of Owncast instance URLs (e.g., "owncast.example.com,stream.another.com")

key.name: update-interval
key.description: How often to poll Owncast instances for status updates

key.name: opencmd
key.description: Command to execute when clicking on a streamer. %instance% will be replaced with the instance URL

key.name: hideplaylists
key.description: Hide the panel icon when no streams are live

key.name: notifications
key.description: Show desktop notifications when streamers go live

key.name: notification-icons
key.description: Display the Owncast instance logo in notifications

key.name: topbar-mode
key.description: How to display stream information in the top panel: text_only, count_only, or icon_only

key.name: sort-key
key.description: How to sort the stream list: name, viewers, or uptime
